verdict.rationale: Relay documents high-yield savings earning up to 3.00% APY, with auto-transfer rules that sweep idle cash into savings. A community user confirms earning extra interest on allocated funds. However, nothing in the evidence shows Relay holds balances in currencies other than USD; it only mentions sending and receiving international wires. Missing for 10: multi-currency account balances, interest on non-USD balances, rate/terms detail per currency.
